Excellent! Tests pass and TypeScript type checking is clean. 

## Summary

Fixed the pagination bug in `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts` line 16. The issue was that the `page` parameter from the query string (`ListPostsQuerySchema`) was already 1-indexed (defaults to 1, minimum 1), but the controller was incorrectly incrementing it by 1 before passing it to the `paginate()` method. This caused the pagination to skip the first page and show posts 11-20 on "page 1".

The fix removes the erroneous `+ 1` offset: changed `.paginate({ page: page + 1, perPage: 10 })` to `.paginate({ page, perPage: 10 })`. Now page 1 correctly shows the 10 newest posts, page 2 shows the next 10, and so on.
